summary: Tightened the prose, replaced the unsupported claim that his research 'informed European legislative inquiries' with the sourced fact that his 2025 working paper was cited in a written question to the European Commission, corrected the teaching claim to past tense, and restored omitted details (MINE's 2017 founding, doctorate at Urbino, CooRnet co-developers, rapporteur role).

flags.claim: His empirical research auditing platform content policies has informed European legislative inquiries
flags.issue: A claim about third-party institutional action. The authoritative biography supports only that the 2025 Meta working paper was cited in a written question to the European Commission (E-10-2026-000086); 'informed European legislative inquiries' goes beyond that. Replaced with the precise, supported statement.

flags.claim: his teaching portfolio includes courses on Generative AI and Media and Digital Social Network Analysis
flags.issue: The authoritative biography states his teaching 'has included' these courses; the present-tense 'includes' asserts a currency the source does not. Changed to 'has included'.

flags.claim: He is the founder and coordinator of the Mapping Italian News Research Program (MINE)
flags.issue: The authoritative biography dates the founding to 2017; the biography dropped the date. Restored.

flags.claim: Fabio Giglietto is Full Professor of Internet Studies in the Department of Communication Sciences, Humanities and International Studies at the University of Urbino Carlo Bo
flags.issue: The authoritative biography notes he earned his doctorate at the same institution, a fact the biography omitted. Restored.
The authoritative biography names the co-developers (Nicola Righetti and Luca Rossi) and notes the method was also used by fact-checkers; the biography dropped both. Restored.

flags.claim: bridging theoretical frameworks with advanced empirical methodologies
flags.issue: Empty abstraction that asserts nothing concrete; removed in revision.

flags.claim: he has served as an independent proposal evaluator for the European Education and Culture Executive Agency
flags.issue: The authoritative biography describes the role as 'evaluator and rapporteur'; the rapporteur element was dropped. Restored (without naming the call or programme, per confidentiality rules; the appointment's end date has passed, so it is stated in the past tense).
